data.name: Tales of the Elements
data.detailed_description:
What do you get when you mix Hip Hop, JRPGs, fast-paced action, and 4-player couch co-op?

Tales of the Elements is an indie action role-playing game adaptation of the album of the same name, developed by the album's producer and recording artist, Last BeNeVoLeNcE. While similar to the classic style of Japanese RPGs of the 90s, TotEFC blends Hip Hop music and culture with the characteristics and setting of a traditional JRPG to create a world of fantasy and style!

Starring music producer and recording artist Last BeNeVoLeNcE, the legendary “Chip Hop” pioneer Mega Ran, and Panacea producer K-Murdock!

Key Features:
- Based on the Hip Hop album of the same name
- Japanese-style RPG storytelling like the classics of the 90’s
- True 4-player co-op action battle system with X-Box 360 gamepad support
- A great soundtrack that features a unique blend of Hip Hop and RPG music
- Hip Hop themed mechanics that are rewarding but optional
- Highly challenging gameplay that features light puzzle-solving progression--No maps or quest markers!
- Secret bosses and a hidden unlockable that literally breaks the 4th wall
- Developed by the artist who produced and recorded the album

Tales of the Elements has also been updated with additional features (as of 2018) such as:
- 8 Speed-based 3D Special Stages for unlocking secrets
- Main Cast Character Voiceovers (along with additional supporting cast voiceovers)
- Hand-drawn character dialogue portraits and map sprites.

A free copy of the Tales of the Elements FC album is available when purchasing the game!

data.short_description: Tales of the Elements, a game adaption of the album of the same name, is a mixture of Hip Hop, JRPG, & party-style goodness! Featuring Mega Ran, K-Murdock, and Last BeNeVoLeNcE, experience a fast-paced 2D Japanese-style action RPG for up to 4 players!

reviews.review:
Tales of the Elements is a distinctive indie action RPG that sets itself apart by blending classic fantasy adventure with the culture and sound of hip-hop. Developed by Last BeNeVoLeNcE and published by RandomBeats Music, the game is based on a concept album of the same name, transforming a musical project into a fully playable role-playing experience. Rather than following the conventional path of fantasy RPG storytelling, the game embraces its musical roots and delivers an adventure that feels highly personal and creatively ambitious.

The game's world draws inspiration from traditional Japanese role-playing games while introducing characters and themes influenced by the artists involved in the original album. This combination creates an identity that feels refreshing compared to many retro-inspired indie RPGs. The narrative focuses on a journey through a fantasy realm shaped by elemental powers, with a cast of heroes connected to the music that inspired the project. While the story does not aim for the scale of major AAA role-playing games, it succeeds in creating a unique atmosphere that reflects the passion behind its creation.

Combat takes an action-oriented approach, emphasizing real-time battles instead of turn-based encounters. Players can tackle the adventure alone or team up with up to three friends in local cooperative play. The inclusion of four-player co-op is one of the game's strongest features, adding a social dimension that enhances both combat and exploration. Battles are fast and energetic, requiring movement, timing, and coordination rather than simple menu selections. This keeps the gameplay engaging throughout the adventure and helps the title stand out among other independent RPG releases.

Exploration is another important aspect of the experience. The developers intentionally adopted an old-school design philosophy by limiting modern conveniences such as extensive quest tracking and objective markers. Players are encouraged to pay attention to their surroundings, solve environmental puzzles, and discover secrets through curiosity and experimentation. This approach can be rewarding for fans of classic RPGs who enjoy figuring things out on their own, though newcomers may occasionally find the lack of guidance challenging. Even so, this design choice contributes to the game's nostalgic appeal and reinforces its retro influences.

The soundtrack is undoubtedly one of the game's defining strengths. Given its origins as a music project, it is no surprise that audio plays a central role in shaping the overall experience. The music blends hip-hop rhythms with fantasy-inspired melodies, creating a soundtrack that feels unlike anything found in most RPGs. The songs complement exploration, combat, and story moments while strengthening the game's distinctive identity. The soundtrack is more than background music—it serves as the foundation upon which the entire project was built.

Visually, Tales of the Elements embraces a retro aesthetic that reflects its inspiration from classic console RPGs. Character sprites, environments, and interface elements are designed with nostalgia in mind, while later updates introduced enhancements such as improved artwork, additional voice acting, and extra gameplay content. These additions demonstrate a commitment to refining the experience and adding value beyond the initial release. Although the presentation lacks the technical sophistication of larger productions, it possesses a charm that suits the game's creative vision.

What makes Tales of the Elements memorable is its willingness to pursue an unconventional concept. The fusion of fantasy role-playing, cooperative action gameplay, and hip-hop culture could have easily felt disjointed, but the game manages to combine these influences into a cohesive experience. It is clearly a passion project created by people who wanted to bring something different to the genre rather than simply imitate established formulas.

Tales of the Elements may not appeal to every RPG player, particularly those seeking cutting-edge visuals or a highly polished blockbuster experience. However, for players who appreciate indie creativity, retro design principles, and memorable music, it offers a genuinely unique adventure. Its combination of cooperative gameplay, old-school exploration, and an outstanding soundtrack results in a game that stands out from the crowd and leaves a lasting impression.

Rating: 6/10

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Sistema Operativo *: Microsoft Windows XP / Vista
  • Processador: 2.0 GHz Dual Core or better
  • Memória: 1 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: GPU w/ 1GB Video RAM minimum
  • DirectX: Versão 9.0
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 2 GB de espaço livre
  • Placa de som: DirectX Compatible
  • Notas adicionais: Runs at 640x480 (Press "Alt+Enter" for fullscreen); Because the game engine uses the CPU to process graphics instead of GPU, some parts of the game such as the Special Stages can be CPU intensive for a 2.0 Ghz processor and may require something a bit more powerful; Also--Xbox 360 Gamepad does not work when "Xbox Configuration Support" is activated in Steam Big Picture.
